Deal of the Day: Enjoy 10% off Birkenstock

Put a little spring in your school-day step. 👣

By Samantha Chaney
Oct 8, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:06
Instaread

Between circulating around the classroom, supervising dismissal, and making one last trip to the copier, a teacher can log plenty of time on their feet before the final bell. A supportive pair of shoes or sandals may be worth adding to the rotation, especially when it comes with the Birkenstock teacher discount.

Teachers save 10% on Birkenstock styles

Whether you’re standing through six class periods, pacing during a lesson, or spending recess duty making circles around the playground, a supportive pair of shoes can make those long days a little easier. Birkenstock offers a variety of sandals, clogs, and shoes that many shoppers turn to for everyday wear.

Getting the discount is straightforward. Teachers can verify their status through ID.me during checkout. If you already have an ID.me account, simply sign in. New users can create an account and complete the verification process. Once approved, the 10% discount is applied automatically to eligible purchases.

We’re curious—what else can we help you save on this month?

Email us at editors@weareteachers.com and we’ll try to include your suggestions in our deal roundups. Happy shopping!
